examples.en: Training includes realistic simulation of casualty procedures.
examples.zh: 训练包括伤亡处理程序的实际模拟。

examples.en: To make the training realistic the simulation operates in real time.
examples.zh: 为使训练真实，模拟是实时运行的。

examples.en: The simulation takes no account of the effects of coastal erosion.
examples.zh: 该模拟没有考虑海岸侵蚀的影响。
